import pathlib,hashlib,json,re,datetime
from html.parser import HTMLParser
src=pathlib.Path('products/research/paid-technical-writing/lwn-author-guide.html')
b=src.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='24d0100c811ea18c0d32e30f2eee63e6914464bbab2df1eb9c70e2e05e6200ef'
class Text(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.parts=[]
 def handle_data(self,data): self.parts.append(data)
p=Text();p.feed(b.decode('utf-8'));text=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',' '.join(p.parts))
quotes=['We do not publish text from large language models','please do not send us pitches or articles that have been generated by machines, they will not be considered.']
for q in quotes: assert q in text,q
excerpts=[]
for term in ['$400','PayPal','payment','rights','copyright']:
 matches=list(re.finditer(re.escape(term),text,re.I))
 for m in matches[:4]: excerpts.append({'search_term':term,'source_excerpt':text[max(0,m.start()-180):min(len(text),m.end()+500)]})

Earlier unread publisher pages did not establish prohibition. Next time check explicit authorship terms before preparing a pitch.'}
out=pathlib.Path('products/services/paid-technical-writing/lwn/result.json');out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(out.read_text())
